capabilities: Bundles the engine, layout engine and theme table
Supports plantuml and puml code blocks
Renders Chinese text with system CJK fonts
Applies dark and light themes at render time
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually from Releases. Conflicts with the official PlantUML plugin (same plantuml code block). Chinese rendering needs system CJK fonts on Linux; theme changes require reopening the note. Sends no network requests.
intentEvidence: 官方 PlantUML 插件与它注册同一个 plantuml 代码块，二者只能启用一个。
problem: Rendering PlantUML diagrams otherwise requires network requests to an external service, so diagrams cannot be produced offline.

relations.evidence: 官方 PlantUML 插件与它注册同一个 plantuml 代码块，二者只能启用一个。

summary: Offline PlantUML renderer that bundles the engine and standard library to render plantuml/puml code blocks with no network requests and Chinese support.
